headline: Unknown Architects sinks timber cabin into dune-filled Dutch island
context: Dutch studio Unknown Architects has completed House on a Dune, a holiday cabin on the island of Terschelling with lofty, timber-lined interiors that frame panoramic views of the surrounding sand plains and scrubland. The 180-square-metre holiday home is located in Midsland an Zee

sources.name: Dezeen
